text: player
Welcome to the World of the Nobility!
Xenia
Here we are, {var:player_nickname}. Welcome to my home.
My parents bought this manor for me in the suburbs of One Han City since I decided I'd be staying here for a while.
All of it?!
You showed me a wonderful time at Asaha High School. Ever since I got home, I've been thinking about how to return the favor.
In noble etiquette, a kindness must always be met with a kindness of equal worth.
So, after much consideration, I thought, why not play the guide myself and invite you to my home?
I'd hardly call this "equal worth"!
I'm honored...
No need to be so polite. You deserve it... So, please allow me to welcome you properly.
Welcome... to my manor, {var:player_nickname}.
My lady... you've brought this dangerous individual to the manor after all.
Huh?! "Dangerous individual"... a-are you talking about me?
My apologies... {var:player_nickname}. This is Marie, the head housekeeper of my manor. Marie, what is this all about?
Marie
My lady, according to my intel, your guest is closely involved with several questionable factions in One Han City.
Xenia, I can explain...
Marie, I always respect your opinion, but that doesn't mean you can overstep your authority and control my social life.
I trust {var:player_nickname}, just as I trust you. So I hope you will treat {var:player_nickname} with the same respect. Is that clear?
Yes, my lady. I understand. But today is a special day for you... Are you sure you want to...
Shush!
I see, my lady. I shall make an exception, just this once.
What special day?
It's nothing. But trust me, you're going to love what I have planned for today!
This way, Jyanshi {var:player_nickname}. I will accompany my lady to ensure both of your safety.
(Stares)
This feeling of being watched is...
Surely there's no danger in Xenia's home, is there?
You have nothing to worry about, so long as neither you nor my lady does anything to trigger a "Servant Code"...
"Servant Code"? What's that?
It's a set of special orders my family created for the servants at the manor to constrain my behavior and protect me.
That's horrifying!
But the trigger conditions are really strict, so don't worry, {var:player_nickname}. Just come with me.
We're coming up on the main walkway of the manor. Look –
Maids
Good afternoon, Lady Xenia!
The buggy pulls up to the main residence. Maids line both sides of the road, bowing in perfect sync as it passes.
Xenia, we've already seen a lake of swans, two meadows, and three different gardens...
How big IS your home?!
Um... I don't know the exact area, but I think it's measured in square kilometers?
Square... kilometers...
Hehe, you've probably seen enough scenery for one day. Come on, let's go see the house I live in!
Hang on! Didn't you just say we were done with the scenery? What is this place?
Hmm? I did. This is my dressing room. I had it decorated in the style of a rainforest I visited. Here, if you pull back this curtain, you'll see my clothes hanging on the branches.
If this were my closet, I'd probably never be able to find my clothes...
This is my study. It's modeled after a famous technopolis.
Well, you can make the books appear by pressing the right button. Like this!
Oh – that button is for incinerating my discarded drafts. Be very careful with it.
Why would you install something so dangerous in your house?!
Alright, {var:player_nickname}, any guesses as to what this place is?
A... a ski slope? Having an indoor ski slope is just too much to wrap my head around, even for a noble...
You're right. Even though it's all snowy white, it doesn't feel cold at all.
Oh, there's equipment to simulate a winter chill by dropping the temperature below zero, too.
Let's not do that! I would certainly catch a cold!
Anyway... the decor and furnishings in these rooms are inspired by places I've traveled. They are, in a way, my souvenirs.
Indeed... It feels like I'm experiencing Xenia's travels for myself...
Thank you for the compliment.
I'll never forget my travels... Every time a landscape captures my heart, I have to keep that moment with me always.
Isn't that what cameras are for? You know, to remember a nice view?
Maybe, but unlike a photo, these memories become a living, breathing part of my life.
Take the bathroom you're in now. I had it designed in the style of the famous City of Water.
When I traveled there, I happened to arrive during the annual carnival. I followed the festive crowd through every street and alley of that city.
Didn't anyone recognize you?
Nope, because I wore a mask.
So I could walk and eat without caring about my image.
I could even dance with the street bands until my dress was all wrinkled, and nobody would care.
The way you describe it sounds quite appealing...
I'd love to see that side of you, Xenia.
It is. It's a memory I cherish.
But back then, I was so worried about what would happen if anyone found out it was me.
That's why I hope that one day, I can enjoy the celebration and just be myself.
When that time comes, you'll join me, right, {var:player_nickname}?
I bet you'd be adorable.
W-what, are you saying I'm not just as cute on a normal day?
But I do miss that part of me...
If it's with you, I think I'll have even more fun than last time.
It's settled then! You're coming with me to the carnival next year!
Ahem... Excuse me.
Can't we just take one day off? I have a guest.
B-but...
If you refuse, I will be forced to report this to your father.
...So stuffy.
Fine, I'll go. But I'm taking my guest with me.
Wait, I have to do it too?!
Easy, Lysander –
A restless, snow-white horse paws at the ground before rearing up. Unafraid, Xenia gently soothes its neck. As the horse calms and lowers its head, she vaults onto its back in one fluid motion.
Atop her horse, Xenia's usual elegance is amplified by a commanding dignity.
So cool...
Who knew Xenia could do that?
Lysander is the wildest horse in the entire manor... impossible for anyone to tame. He only submits to Lady Xenia.
My lady doesn't usually let outsiders near Lysander. To think she brought out her favorite horse for you today...
It seems you're... more important to her than I thought.
Jyanshi {var:player_nickname}.
The way you're staring at me so seriously is a little scary...
She can be quite impulsive. If you could, please try to keep her reined when you're around her.
You have my word, Marie.
Is there something you're not telling me?
Then thank you for your understanding.
So, what do you think, {var:player_nickname}? Bet you've never seen this side of me before, huh?
Your riding skills are incredible...
Thank you, but it's not about showing off. Horses are sensitive animals. The more you rush, the more anxious they get. Think of it as a lesson in patience.
I guess not all of those lessons are so terrible.
No, of course not. I hated etiquette class so much that I once glued my tutor's wig to his chair... As punishment, my father sent me to the stables to "think about it."
No one bothered me in there. I'd just crouch down and talk to the horses. They'd swish their tails, or come and nuzzle my hand with their heads.
My father said that having a way with animals is a sign of a true noble. So, naturally, he signed me up for equestrian lessons... but it turns out I actually love riding.
I just hate having to be so fake for the "honor of the family."
The whole point of noble etiquette should be to express your true dignity and character from the inside out – to be a genuine example for people, not just playing a part.
Xenia...
I used to only be able to say all this to the horses. But now... with you here, I can finally say it out loud.
Not at all. Anything is fun as long as I'm with you, Xenia.
Me too... Time just flies when you're around.
My lady, Jyanshi {var:player_nickname} cannot stay at the manor any longer.
I must remind you that you need to prepare for tonight's event.
Of course I haven't forgotten about that.
Marie, I'll be straight with you.
{var:player_nickname}... is my dance partner tonight.
Uh...
Inviting Jyanshi {var:player_nickname} here today, my lady... I trust you understand you've put me in a rather difficult position.
You figured it out already, didn't you, Marie? But I'm not backing down.
Um... I have a question...
My lady, this is highly inappropriate. You are the jewel of the family, whereas {var:player_nickname} is merely...
{var:player_nickname} is my muse.
Marie, {var:player_nickname} is the very reason this art gala is happening tonight. So, of course, there's no one better suited to be my partner.
Wait! Can you two please answer me...
What's this about an art gala?
I didn't know I could dance...
{var:player_nickname}, you didn't think I'd repay you with just a simple tour of the manor, did you? I wanted it to be a surprise gift.
Do you remember what happened at Asaha High?
The arts festival organized by the students left a deep impression on me. So I thought, for aspiring artists, the most important thing is an opportunity to express themselves.
And my status as a noble is perfect for building a grand stage for people who are chasing their artistic dreams.
So the "special day" Marie kept talking about... she meant this gala?
Of course. This is the first gala I've ever hosted by myself.
In my family, hosting your own banquet is a strong symbol of independence – so the dance partner I choose will naturally be the center of everyone's attention.
{var:player_nickname}, will you be my dance partner tonight?
My lady, you're not only inviting a commoner to the gala, you're choosing one as your dance partner... If the Count finds out...
Marie, {var:player_nickname} is a companion I've acknowledged, and those common artists are treasures I want to discover. That's all that matters.
{var:player_nickname}, I worked so hard to make this gala happen. Please, you have to stay and be my partner tonight.
It would be my honor, Xenia.
My lady, I still think this matter warrants further discussion.
There's nothing to discuss, Marie. It's decided. You should trust my judgment. {var:player_nickname} won't let you down, and we won't disgrace the family.
Servant
My lady, ma'am, dreadful news –
What is it? Such panic. How unseemly.
M-my apologies, ma'am! A message just arrived. Ms. Lillian is unwell and will not be attending the gala.
Xenia & Marie
What?!

Ms. Lillian is a world-class musician acclaimed by the elite. Her performance is what guarantees the standard of this gala. If she is unable to attend, then I cannot approve a lineup consisting only of common performers.
My lady, the gala must be canceled.
Canceled?!
No! Who cares if we don't have a big name? The performances by the guests I invited are amazing too!
My lady, for the sake of the honor of the family, I will not allow it.
You should understand that the honor of the family is the most important thing.
To me, it is more important that everyone's dreams are respected!
Jyanshi {var:player_nickname}... do you remember what you promised me? You'll convince her to cancel the gala, won't you?
No way. {var:player_nickname} will definitely take my side.
Support Xenia's decision to hold the gala tonight.
Convince Xenia to hold the gala on another day.
Marie, I'll support Xenia, no matter what.
Marie
Jyanshi {var:player_nickname}, you promised you wouldn't let my lady do anything rash that would compromise her status.
But I have faith in Xenia.
Back at Asaha High School, her unconventional idea for an outdoor photo exhibit ended up winning everyone over.
The way I see it, even though Xenia can be stubborn, she's not unreasonable. And most importantly, she's mature enough to take responsibility for her own decisions.
Xenia, you must have been preparing for this gala for a very long time, right?
{var:player_nickname}, I knew I was right about you.
My lady, if you agree to one condition of mine, I will allow the gala to go on.

If this gala turns out to be a disaster, I will accept punishment from the Count for my failure as a guardian. But you must personally take the stage and show everyone, in your own way, that this gala is worthwhile and worthy of your name.
I accept. But...
Even if you hadn't made that a condition, Marie, I was going to prove that to everyone anyway!
No need to be nervous. Since you are to be my lady's dance partner, you'll need to go through a rigorous etiquette bootcamp before the gala begins.
I have compromised far too much today. This is non-negotiable.
A bootcamp?! No one said anything about a bootcamp!
Well, she has a point. I'd rather not see your arms and legs all going in different directions. Good luck.
Under her guidance, I managed to complete the entire dance, albeit a bit clumsily.
{var:player_nickname}, how was it? Today's gift was worthy of my name, right?
Of course... The scenery at the manor was amazing, but the radiant Xenia was even more unforgettable...
Hehe, then you'd better remember today and every bit of it.
I will, Xenia.
I used to think freedom meant being able to travel wherever I wanted...
{var:player_nickname}, when you stood by my decision today, I realized what I want isn't "the freedom to escape a cage."
What I want... is a companion.
A companion?
Xenia takes a deep breath and looks at me, her eyes sparkling.
{var:player_nickname}, will you... be my companion?
Of course.
I think I already am?
I can't wait to see more of the world through your eyes, Xenia.
Hehe, has my confidence been rubbing off on you?
Ahem...
It's late, Jyanshi {var:player_nickname}. Time to go home. Family rules state that outsiders are not allowed to stay overnight in my lady's residence.
Not this again... The manor is huge. {var:player_nickname} is staying here tonight!
{var:player_nickname}, let's go!
Ignoring Marie's desperate cries, Xenia grabs my wrist and runs up the stairs.
No one follows us!
Xenia... are you kidnapping me?
Of course not. There's a family gathering next month, and I don't want to go –
{var:player_nickname}, help me run away, please? Let's travel, see more of the world, and build stages for more "hidden treasures"!
A mission this important needs a solid plan!
Hehe... I'm counting on you, then. I can't wait.
Marie, I agree that we should postpone the gala.
{var:player_nickname}? You think I'm being unreasonable, too?
Of course not, Xenia. I know you mean well.
But I think the artists would also be excited to meet Ms. Lillian. Perhaps postponing it will make for an even better event for everyone.
You have a point... Thank you for the reminder, {var:player_nickname}.
My lady, I will reschedule with Ms. Lillian. I'm sure you'll be able to host a wonderful gala on another day.
That's wonderful. But the artists I invited are already on their way. We can't let them come all this way for nothing...
Hey, Maestro! You can see the entire swan lake from the top of that tree! I bet you'll love it! Wanna climb up with me?
Nooo!
Everyone, keep up! The next stop on our inspiration tour is my rose garden!
For the rest of the day, Xenia decides to play tour guide for the visiting commoner artists. She appoints me as her "assistant," and together we lead them on a tour of the manor.
For artists who rarely get a chance to experience the world of the nobility, it must have been a fascinating day.
I guess rescheduling wasn't so bad. Everyone's even more inspired for their performances now.
Everything you can see from this point on is part of my home.
My lady, it is time for your training session.
You promised to do this in exchange for time to travel. As a noble, I urge you to be responsible for your own words and actions.
And besides, there's something else on the agenda today... so training cannot be canceled.

Fortunately, today is the equestrian class. A canter around the grounds is so much more pleasant than standing perfectly still for deportment. Please, {var:player_nickname}, come with me. I have a friend I would very much like you to know.
Some time later, after the equestrian training...
{var:player_nickname}, I know today's schedule was a bit out of my control. I hope you don't mind.
Anyway, training for today is over! Now it's our free time.
Very good. As for you, Jyanshi {var:player_nickname}... you must come with me.
Still, {var:player_nickname}, I feel what I did for you today wasn't everything it could have been. I'll make it up to you, and it'll be perfect next time!
Huh? Technopolis? But this just looks like an ordinary study to me...
Just take it as a friendly warning.
We're here already? But that house is still so far away...
Oh? Did I forget to mention? The gate we just passed was the main entrance to my home.
Me? With questionable factions?
I guess you could call them... a series of emergency measures the servants take if something happens. The most extreme, Servant Code Red, could escalate to a city-wide lockdown...
Wow, that's amazing... So what's this red button for?
Hehe, this is the dessert room. You can try all sorts of desserts if you open that invisible fridge over there. We have the snow maintained in here year-round, of course.
So elegant! Simply graceful!
But my guests are already on their way! They've been looking forward to performing today for so long!
What now, Marie?
Huh? G-go where?
Help me! Xenia?!
When all the performances had come to a smooth close later that day, Xenia took my hand, leading me to center stage.
...Phew.
Mm-hm... You know, the kind of important companion I can do everything with – like going to the school arts festival, eating fish balls at the cafeteria, or just going anywhere we want...!
Marie?! Not you again!
A noble lady is absolutely forbidden from having a commoner stay the night! How improper... My lady! At least don't bring an outsider into your bedroom! That's a Servant Code Blue!
Ah, I've got it! There might be a way to save the day!
My lady, you will NOT be climbing trees like the last time with the painter! Nor are you to take guests to the cellar for "inspiration"! Our fine wines are not playthings!
